  Special Meeting Agenda
  CITY COUNCIL

Tuesday, February 13, 2024  Council Chamber

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor has called a Special Meeting of the City Council, to be called to
order in the Council Chamber immediately at the close of the Regular City Council meeting on Tuesday, February
13, 2024. The agenda for the Special Meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is set forth
below.
Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Monday, February 12, 2024, at 3:00 pm.

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

2.  NEW BUSINESS

  A.  ENVIRONMENTAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE AND TRAFFIC & SAFETY
  COMMITTEE VACANCY APPOINTMENTS
  Memorandum from Lauren Pettit, City Clerk
  Recommendation: That the City Council make the appointment to fill the two (2)
  vacancies on the Environmental Advisory Committee and one (1) vacancy on the
  Traffic & Safety Committee from the list of candidates.
  Attachments: Staff Report

3.  ADJOURNMENT

Americans With Disabilities Act: In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the
City Clerk's office at (310) 377-1577 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  FEBRUARY 13, 2024

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR SCHMITZ at 8:03 PM.

  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
City Council Members Absent:  None

2.  NEW BUSINESS

A.  ENVIRONMENTAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE  AND  TRAFFIC  &  SAFETY
  COMMITTEE VACANCY APPOINTMENTS

  MAYOR PRO TEM STEGURA moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER
  SCHACHTER, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL
  VOTE:

  APPOINT MICAH RAPOPORT AND CLAIRE WILLIAMS TO FILL THE TWO
  VACANCIES ON THE ENVIRONMENTAL ADVISORY COMMITTEE.

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

  COUNCIL MEMBER SCHACHTER moved, seconded by COUNCIL MEMBER
  HUFF, TO APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  APPOINT RYAN HALVORSEN AND DAVID ROWE TO THE TRAFFIC &
  SAFETY COMMITTEE.

  AYES:  Brown Schachter, Huff, Schmitz, Stegura, Zerunyan
  ABSENT:  None

3.  ADJOURNMENT

MAYOR SCHMITZ adjourned the Special City Council meeting to the regular City Council
meeting on February 27, 2024 at 7:00 PM.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Velveth Schmitz
City Clerk  Mayor

SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
FEBRUARY 13, 2024
